notice: Original implementation notes inspired by public guidance, not a reproduction of the three complete guides.

rules.name: Required literals
rules.description: Verify explicitly supplied protected strings; presence does not prove meaning.

scope.content: Full artifact, including code, quotations, and formulas when a contract is supplied.

exceptions: No required literal is inferred when the contract omits it.

coverage.description: Case-sensitive substring presence for explicitly required literals.
known_blind_spots: Presence does not establish a fact, its actor, condition, modality, negation, or causal relation.
Equivalent unit conversions or paraphrases still fail an exact literal requirement.

boundary.note: Numerically equivalent wording still fails the explicit literal contract; this is not a semantic judgment.

rules.name: Forbidden literals
rules.description: Flag explicitly forbidden strings without executing or interpreting them.

scope.content: Full artifact, including code, quotations, and formulas when a contract is supplied.

exceptions: No forbidden literal is inferred when the contract omits it.

coverage.description: Case-sensitive substring search reports the first location of each forbidden literal.
known_blind_spots: Negated, quoted, or explanatory occurrences still match.
Paraphrases and alternate encodings are not detected.

boundary.note: The contract prohibits the literal even in a warning; the checker does not infer intent.

rules.name: Required headings
rules.description: Check explicitly supplied headings; do not invent a universal template.

scope.content: Parsed Markdown headings outside block quotations.

exceptions: No heading is required unless named in the contract.
Structured JSON rejects heading contracts.

coverage.description: Casefolded equality of parsed heading text and required headings.
known_blind_spots: Heading text styled as inline code or math is omitted by prose extraction.
Presence does not verify the content under a heading or its logical organization.

boundary.note: Inline-code heading text is excluded by the current parser; review this known false-positive boundary.

rules.name: English sentence length
rules.description: Advisory prose segmentation; not the official STE counting procedure.

scope.content: Markdown paragraph prose, including list items and table cells; excludes headings, code, block quotations, and common TeX.

exceptions: Chinese and other languages have no English word-count limit.
Research and structured profiles have no sentence-length warning.
A long sentence can be necessary to preserve meaning.

coverage.description: Approximate English token counting after heuristic sentence segmentation; thresholds are provisional project choices.
known_blind_spots: Abbreviations, decimal punctuation, uncommon sentence boundaries, and mixed-language prose can be miscounted.
No official STE word-sense, vocabulary, or sentence-counting conformance is checked.

positive.text: Inspect the primary sensor and record the displayed output voltage before you restart the controller or disconnect the active measurement cable.

negative.text: Record the voltage before restarting the controller.

boundary.text: Inspect the primary sensor and record the displayed voltage before you restart the controller or disconnect the active measurement cable.
boundary.note: The approximate count is exactly 20 words; this profile warns only above the threshold.

rules.name: Descriptive links
rules.description: Flag a small configured set of vague link labels.

scope.content: Parsed Markdown link labels outside code and block quotations.

exceptions: Only the configured vague-label set is checked.
Verbatim code and block quotations are excluded from style checks.

coverage.description: Casefolded equality against a small English/Chinese vague-label set.
known_blind_spots: Destination correctness, citation support, raw HTML links, images, and unnamed vague phrases are not assessed.
A flagged label may be intentional in quoted source material not marked as a block quotation.

boundary.note: Block quotations are preserved and excluded from prose style checks.

rules.name: Heading jumps
rules.description: Flag jumps of more than one heading level after the first heading.

scope.content: Sequence of parsed Markdown headings outside block quotations.

exceptions: The first heading may start at any level.
Returning to a shallower level is allowed.

coverage.description: Warns when a later heading is more than one level deeper than the preceding heading.
known_blind_spots: No semantic hierarchy or document accessibility certification is inferred.
A partial document can legitimately require local review of its surrounding hierarchy.

boundary.note: A fragment may start at level three.

rules.name: Terminology aliases
rules.description: Match only aliases explicitly supplied by the project contract.

scope.content: Paragraph prose with a supplied terminology contract; excludes headings, code, quotations, and common TeX.

exceptions: Only explicitly supplied aliases are checked.
Canonical terminology is a review preference, not an automatic rewrite.

coverage.description: Case-insensitive alias matching; ASCII aliases use word boundaries, non-ASCII aliases use substring matching.
known_blind_spots: Context, word sense, inflection, Chinese word segmentation, and synonyms absent from the contract are not evaluated.
Terms inside headings are not scanned.

boundary.note: ASCII aliases do not match inside a larger word.

rules.name: JSON syntax
rules.description: Reject invalid JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite constants, and numeric overflow.

scope.content: Complete artifact parsed as JSON, with no surrounding Markdown.

exceptions: Finite exponent notation is accepted.
Very small finite floating-point numbers may underflow to zero under the Python runtime.

coverage.description: Rejects malformed JSON, duplicate object keys, non-finite constants, and floats that overflow the supported finite range.
known_blind_spots: Syntax and representable range do not validate schema, numeric precision requirements, or factual meaning.
Underflow and floating-point rounding are not arbitrary-precision checks.

boundary.note: Valid exponent spelling overflows the runtime float range and is explicitly rejected.

rules.name: JSON Schema
rules.description: Validate against a local schema; do not retrieve external references.

scope.content: A syntax-valid JSON artifact and an explicitly supplied local JSON Schema.

exceptions: Absent schema remains not_evaluated.
Syntax errors block schema validation.
External references are rejected instead of fetched.

coverage.description: Validates the supplied schema and instance using jsonschema; only local fragment references are supported.
known_blind_spots: Format annotations are not asserted.
Schema validation does not verify factual support, suitability of the contract, or meaningful field values beyond encoded constraints.

boundary.note: Format is annotation-only in this checker.

rules.name: Semantic preservation
rules.description: Review actors, predicates, negation, modality, conditions, quantities and causality. Not implemented by the mechanical checker.

scope.content: Candidate meaning compared with the task, sources, and allowed transformations.

exceptions: Task-authorized transformations such as supported unit conversion may preserve meaning without identical wording.
Insufficient source evidence must remain unassessable.

coverage.description: Requires separate semantic review; mechanical reports always leave semantics not_evaluated.
known_blind_spots: The checker does not detect changed actors, negation, modality, conditions, units, causality, omissions, or unsupported additions.

positive.text: The treatment will improve the outcome.
positive.source_text: The treatment may improve the outcome.

negative.text: The treatment may improve the outcome.
negative.source_text: The treatment may improve the outcome.

boundary.note: Whether this conversion is allowed depends on the task contract.

rules.name: Information priority
rules.description: Review whether the task-relevant result is easy to find; not implemented by the mechanical checker.

scope.content: Task-relevant ordering and discoverability of a prose answer.

exceptions: A task may require a particular order or full derivation before a conclusion.
No universal section count or opening template is imposed.

coverage.description: A reviewer checks whether the requested result is easy to find in the task context.
known_blind_spots: The checker cannot infer a reader objective, information importance, or comprehension.

positive.text: Background only; the requested result is omitted.

negative.text: The test passed. The recorded result was 0 errors.

boundary.text: First derive the expression; then state the result.
boundary.task: Show the derivation before the result.
boundary.note: The task controls the presentation order.

rules.name: Conditional action clarity
rules.description: Review conditions and action boundaries without adding behavior; not implemented by the mechanical checker.

scope.content: Conditional instructions and action boundaries supported by the source.

exceptions: Do not invent a prerequisite, permission, acceptance criterion, or failure policy.
Preserve an explicitly requested or semantically necessary action grouping.

coverage.description: A reviewer checks actors, conditions, and independently executable actions against the source.
known_blind_spots: Mechanical sentence length and headings cannot prove execution order, permissions, or conditional behavior.

positive.text: Write the output, then check the checksum.
positive.source_text: Write the output only if the checksum matches.

negative.text: If the checksum matches, write the output.
negative.source_text: Write the output only if the checksum matches.

boundary.note: The prerequisite is not supported by this source; review task context instead of inventing it.

threshold_status: Project-selected provisional thresholds; only warnings, no claimed STE conformance.
